protocol.aggregation: Paired differences are computed within identical inputs before medians. Official simulated three-seed medians precede equal-weight event summaries. Different diagnostic cohorts are never subtracted as causal pairs. Within1/2 is finite-finishers density; starters/DNF/non-starters separately retained.
protocol.frozenData: Old numeric matrices and90new population/path solos execute3b837b. Their full-source inverse to51caabc is verified; controller/prediction/aero execute51caabc. No old row overwritten or relabelled as current rerun.
protocol.identificationLimit: Internal interventions identify current-engine effects only. Real fields, ability selection, carried weights and per-horse trajectories are not reconstructed; no exact allocation of real residual to every cause is claimed.

metrics.label: 首末完赛秒差
metrics.cause: 能力映射、原始阵容、路线与控制共同作用；前段和末段优势叠加，而非仅末段离散不足。

metrics.label: 冠军后1秒内完赛者比例
metrics.cause: 与全程差距同源；要检查中心完赛密度和前末段补偿，不能仅压缩末段方差。

metrics.label: 冠军后2秒内完赛者比例
metrics.cause: 与上项同源；记录精度干预不能解释差距。

metrics.label: 全场个体末600米用时极差
metrics.cause: 诊断支持自然请求与供能约束没有充分激发末段历史分化；已有生理能够分化，真实贡献和参数仍未识别。

metrics.label: 首马起步200米用时
metrics.cause: 加速/最高速度映射与中长程保守请求均有因果证据；供能建立并非当前主约束。

metrics.label: 起步后领跑200米分段CV
metrics.cause: 恒定余程请求的控制问题、路线与领跑者选择共同作用；缺少对获胜和对手响应的明确规划。

metrics.label: 最后200米减前200米
metrics.cause: 需求仍低于衰减上限、预算渐放开、路线和耗尽时点共同作用；并非没有疲劳，现实也不总减速。

metrics.label: 冠军全程标称均速
metrics.cause: 起步慢掩盖余程过快，需联合识别能力/耗能/控制；不能整体调快修起步。

metrics.label: 最快领跑200米标称均速
metrics.cause: 总体中位数接近只是局部量级接近；持续高速的时长、距离分布和速度曲线仍失真。

metrics.label: 冠亚军完赛秒差
metrics.cause: 优势跨段叠加和位置策略不足；秒差与裁判马身着差口径不同。

prefixAndFinishAssociation.protocol: Real B is official estimated closing3F (推定上り), not independent GPS timing. A=T-B is a derived prefix proxy with shared estimation/measurement error; simulated T/B quantized to0.1s. Descriptive median within-event values across24events. Winners are selected on T; these are not independent causal tests or directly measured first-to-last600 checkpoint ranks.

abilityHomogenizationConfound.warning: Equal-ability resets stats before v8 legacy migration. physiologySeed includes initial stats; latent profiles also change. This comparison is a joint input intervention, never pure attribute homogenization.

protocol.fixed: One neutral70 horse, fixed reference lane, same delay/RNG/weight. No opponents, AI, hills or wind. All variants disable turn work and turn speed caps; geometry still supplies arc length.
protocol.scope: Permanent full shielding is a counterfactual upper-benefit scenario, not an actual pack. Air removal is a numerical bound inside this plant. Reallocation holds total steady straight work only at18m/s; at other speeds total work differs. 17% is a rough study estimate, not measured for these horses or an accepted coefficient.
protocol.sourceMutation: A single exact in-memory powerTerms marker exposes permanent shielding. Parameters changed only on separately compiled module objects. Production source and old reports are never rewritten.

protocol.identification: Exploratory constructed local counterexamples after source review; not preregistered real-data calibration, not naturally observed AI decisions.
protocol.state: One neutral70 horse per instance, full guts, established aerobic output, prescribed s/v/lane/reserve. Construction is intentional and not sampled from a natural race.
protocol.forecastScope: Actual production H.finishPlan queried. Nine-step budget reproduction is guarded by its exact production text. Full horse JSON is hashed before and after every forecast query.
protocol.limit: Natural occurrence frequency, the sign/size of population effects and an actual over-strict rejection counterfactual remain unidentified. No adaptive policy or pack execution is performed.

developmentAccounting.scope: Recorded prior invocations plus current artifact invocation, counted separately from actual stepped race experiments.

wakeGeometry.caveat: Geometric eligibility only. No assertion that all such initial two-horse configurations pass the complete traffic safety domain.
wakeGeometry.forecastDraftDistanceScope: Nominal own progress; not the physical 12m following-gap range. The current forecast does not propagate gap or lateral alignment.

witnesses.naturalAiOutcome: Not tested. The attack branch precedes follow; these states may choose attack and never evaluate the follow branch.
Not tested. The attack branch precedes follow; these states may choose attack and never evaluate the follow branch.

structuralRisk.checkDuration: All remaining route from current state
missingPropagation: Following changes speed, reserve, guts and aerobic output before catch begins.
Catch must recover actual executed lost distance inside its feasible action window.
Both opponent gap and lateral alignment determine actual shielding over time.
structuralRisk.overlyStrictRejection: Plausible from code structure; not claimed as demonstrated by an exact executed counterfactual here.

causes.classification: 可确认敏感性；真实参数尚未识别
causes.finding: 起步之后的累计时间偏快，起步偏慢；加速、速度与耗能映射必须联合识别。

causes.classification: 已确认机制不一致；量级有限
causes.finding: finishPlan冻结未来guts，实际执行继续疲劳；可行预算请求误差最大约0.52s，本平坦样本不是数秒裂散的唯一原因。

causes.classification: 代码确认控制目标受限；对现实残差的总贡献未识别
causes.finding: 单一恒定余程请求与局部位置附加缺乏明确胜率/对手响应规划，自然用力历史不充分。

causes.classification: 代码和构造反例确认具体机制不一致；自然发生频率/总效应未识别
causes.finding: AI与物理遮挡区域不同；短时跟跑/追回用全余程恒定请求可行性代替，速度截断后没有验证实际追回距离。

causes.classification: 输入干预已确认；实际群体分布与反事实AI仍未识别
causes.finding: 生理画像×保留指令改变末段约束/补偿；旧等属性对照同时重采样生理，不能当纯属性因果。

causes.classification: 内部量级已确认；现实系数未识别
causes.finding: 18m/s基准空气项仅4.47%稳态需求，默认遮挡省总需求1.25%；存在有效节能但现实相对份额待实测。

causes.classification: 口径与选择效应已确认；无法解释全部残差
causes.finding: 领跑/冠军/个体分段、标称距离/真实弧长、事前跑法/事后标签应分别验收；四舍五入不是主因。

causes.classification: 有结构简化/缺项；尚无本轮独立因果量级
causes.finding: 实际阵容筛选/负重/个体纵向数据、供氧与推进力状态、真实发走/路面/风/转弯横向动力学仍缺独立轨迹识别。

priorities: 让预测传播已有执行状态，记录每步真正的速度/功率/加速约束；作为实现基础验收，不宣称独自修完现实差距。
把恒定余程请求扩展为少量连续可支付动作，比较位置价值、获胜目标与附近对手响应；用力历史由局势产生。
锁定生理/行为后改变属性，锁定属性/指令后改变生理；用同等级和距离筛选的阵容识别联合能力映射。
联合校准首200/400/600与余程持续速度、空气/其他耗能份额；若同组参数无法解释独立轨迹，再增加推进力/供氧等状态。
按留出年份/场地验收全场密度、前末段关系、leader/winner/individual节奏和预先设定的骑手意图；保留失败样本。
